reviews.body: LGTM, thanks. I checked WOWII definitions 45, 66, 90 and 112 in the [archived JavaScript](https://web.archive.org/web/20220130133625id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/wowIIdefs.js). The source defines the mode count explicitly for multiple modes; the two tied modes in this witness avoid its unstated unique-mode convention. The crossing-edge term counts each edge once, and the six private-vertex pairs force 12 selections against bound 10. The pinned external audit repeats the statement and definitions; its reported axiom check is author-workflow evidence, not an independent proof replay here.
